**Architect:** Harsh Kumar Gupta  
**Purpose:** Brand-aligned invitation email sent to approved beta testers, reviewers, and pilot partners.  
**Sovereign Boundary:** Adheres to DPDP Act 2023 §9 zero-telemetry disclosure.

### 🛡️ Pilot Guidelines & Data Sovereignty
- **Single-Device Cryptographic Lock:** Upon your first tap, this invitation token binds securely to your physical device to maintain pilot integrity and prevent link oversharing.
- **Instant URL Scrubbing:** Within 1 millisecond of opening, the token is automatically wiped from your browser address bar to protect against screenshot leaks.
- **100% On-Device Sovereignty:** Under India’s *Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 §9*, your reflections, assessments, and AI Mentor chats remain 100% encrypted on your device.

## Format 2: Production-Ready HTML Email

The complete, responsive HTML source code with dark-mode styling and inline CSS is located at:  
👉 [`docs/templates/beta-approval-email.html`](./beta-approval-email.html)

### How to Send Using Gmail or Webmail:
1. Open [`docs/templates/beta-approval-email.html`](./beta-approval-email.html) in your browser (double-click the file).
2. Press `Ctrl + A` (Select All) then `Ctrl + C` (Copy).
3. In Gmail or Outlook, compose a new email and paste (`Ctrl + V`). The styled dark card, glowing button, and branding will render in the email body!
4. Replace `{{NAME}}`, `{{ROLE}}`, `{{TOKEN}}`, and `{{MAGIC_LINK}}` with the applicant's specific details.
5. Click **Send**!
